ops.oldText: EXCEPT FOR LIABILITY ARISING UNDER SECTION 8 OF THIS AGREEMENT, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF THIS AGREEMENT OR THE USE OR PERFORMANCE OF THE SOFTWARE EXCEED THE TOTAL AMOUNT ACTUALLY PAID BY CORIO HEREUNDER FOR THE TRANSACTION WHICH THE LIABILITY RELATES TO DURING THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRIOR TO THE FILING OF THE CAUSE OF ACTION TO WHICH THE LIABILITY RELATES.
ops.newText: EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF THIS AGREEMENT OR THE USE OR PERFORMANCE OF THE SOFTWARE EXCEED THE GREATER OF (A) THE TOTAL AMOUNT PAID OR PAYABLE BY CORIO HEREUNDER DURING THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRIOR TO THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO THE LIABILITY AND (B) ONE MILLION U.S. DOLLARS (US$1,000,000). "EXCLUDED CLAIMS" MEANS LIABILITY ARISING UNDER SECTION 8 OF THIS AGREEMENT, A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY OBLIGATIONS UNDER SECTION 10, AND A PARTY'S GROSS NEGLIGENCE, WILLFUL MISCONDUCT OR FRAUD.

input.comment: [Playbook] We aligned the mutual cap with our position — the greater of twelve months' fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000 — because limiting recovery to the fees for the single "transaction which the liability relates to" can leave the cap far below twelve months' fees. We also confirmed that indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence, willful misconduct and fraud sit outside the cap.
input.summary: Make the mutual cap the greater of 12 months' fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000, and add confidentiality, gross negligence, willful misconduct and fraud to the existing Section 8 carve-out.
